object_description: two equal-depth buildings with contrasting facade expressions
design_condition: Two buildings continue the surrounding rhythm while leaving two unhierarchical gaps, forming a minimally equipped courtyard and a publicly oriented roof space.

positive.statement: The two buildings continue the heterogeneous character of the district through contrasting expressions.

position.rationale: Two distinct compact volumes are visible across the top and elevation projections.

positive.statement: The public sports field on the roof is a welcome approach to expanding publicly usable space vertically.

position.target: public sports field on the roof
position.rationale: The roof-level sports area is identifiable in the right-hand portion of the top footprint.

positive.statement: The division into sports and school buildings is functionally and operationally conceivable.

position.rationale: Contrasting building portions are distinguishable in plan and elevation views.

positive.statement: The classroom floors are organized advantageously with generous access and a clear structure.

position.rationale: Classroom levels are approximated within the school volume using stacked elevation evidence.

positive.statement: The classrooms are well proportioned and the main entrances are immediately legible.

position.rationale: The entrance-side ground zone is constrained along the front edge of the sampled mass.

positive.statement: The efficient supporting structure makes the flow of forces tangible and resolves the earthquake bracing very well.

position.rationale: Regular structural traces are visible through the elevation point patterns.

positive.statement: Compactness, durable materials, and system separation support good energy and life-cycle performance.

position.rationale: This is an overall performance judgment without a discrete spatial referent.

negative.statement: The sports centre creates two similarly wide gaps without a clear hierarchy.

position.rationale: Two open separations are legible between the compact masses in plan and elevations.

negative.statement: The most expressive facade faces the neighbour and is only visible from the corner, while parking reduces its impact.

position.rationale: A perimeter facade is used as a constrained proxy for the neighbour-facing expressive edge.

negative.statement: It remains unclear whether the connecting material is sufficient to read the two buildings as an ensemble.

position.rationale: The approximate junction between the two volumes anchors the ensemble-reading comment.

negative.statement: The courtyard infrastructure is minimal and the outdoor space is reduced largely to circulation, limiting its quality of stay.

position.rationale: The central open courtyard zone is visible between the building footprints.

negative.statement: The roof sports field places high demands on operation and use and depends on a very clear access solution.

position.rationale: The roof sports area is visible, while its access route is inferred at the roof edge.

negative.statement: The required open-space ratio is not met, even with the roof sports field.

position.rationale: The constrained site anchor lies in the visible open-space gaps surrounding the volumes.

negative.statement: The ground-floor arrangement limits possibilities for spatial demarcation too much.

position.rationale: The ground-level arrangement is located within the school-side footprint at the base.

negative.statement: The mobile separation of preparation and collection rooms does not adequately meet operational requirements and impairs openness when closed.

position.target: mobile separation of preparation and collection rooms
position.rationale: Interior rooms are not distinguishable, so the school volume provides a constrained surface estimate.

negative.statement: The high proportion of glass in the sports halls limits usability.

position.rationale: The sports-hall front facade is approximated on the visible perimeter of the right volume.

negative.statement: The open staircase cannot serve as an escape route and would require extensive fire-protection equipment and an additional stair.

position.rationale: The staircase is interior and unidentifiable, so it is anchored near the school access edge.

negative.statement: The building depth and indeterminate setting are strange in this context, and the resulting small courtyard cannot be adequately compensated for by the roof area.

position.rationale: The elongated massing and narrow central open space are assessed from the complete projections.
